description: This file defines the class tlvSpatialReuseRequest, which represents a specific TLV (Type-Length-Value) structure used in the prplMesh project for spatial reuse requests in Wi-Fi management. It includes data structures, member functions, and bitfield definitions relevant to spatial reuse parameters.

classes.name: tlvSpatialReuseRequest
classes.description: Represents a TLV structure for spatial reuse request parameters, including bitfields for flags and methods for serialization, deserialization, and finalization.
